Protocol matched via libraryts rolling eval (train once, slide over the paper's exact test region: ETT uses rows 11520-14400, dropping the volatile tail; Weather uses 70/10/20). Residual gap: implementation/seed details only. Observed: libraryts lands above the paper on this dataset family (strong trend/regime shift; errors grow with horizon). Likely causes (hypothesis, not verified): the paper selects checkpoints by validation loss with early stopping while libraryts trains a fixed 10 epochs, and sensitivity to the train-statistics normalization.

libraryts baseline run (no public per-dataset values)
libraryts benchmark, this repository · Measured 2026-10-15 via `libraryts train/run --algorithm PyODCBLOFDetector --dataset tsb-yahoo` (model probe-cblof10-yahoo); TSB-UAD README 'Overall Results' table has no CBLOF column
Protocol (as reported)

Tolerance
±0.1 absolute
Last run
2026-10-15 11:53:22 UTC · 72.5s
Notes
TSB-UAD (PVLDB 2022) does not evaluate CBLOF and TSB-AD (NeurIPS 2024) publishes no results for it, so no public per-dataset AUC-ROC exists for these series; the groundtruth is a libraryts baseline measured with this exact pipeline on 2026-10-15. n_clusters=10 instead of the catalog default 8: with 8, pyod CBLOF fails its cluster-separation check on 14/367 YAHOO series. NAB and Genesis are excluded: they contain constant/binary series (NAB_data_art0_1/art0_3, genesis-anomalies.test.csv@17) on which CBLOF cannot form valid clusters at any n_clusters, and libraryts aborts multi-series training on the first failing series. Dodgers is excluded as well: its single series makes the unseeded k-means baseline swing 0.36-0.41 across repeats. k-means is unseeded; three repeat runs of this pipeline spread <=0.012 on the four retained datasets, so tolerance 0.10 is comfortable.

TSB-UAD (PVLDB 2022) does not evaluate KNN, and TSB-AD (NeurIPS 2024) only publishes Sub-KNN averages on its own re-curated datasets, so no public per-dataset AUC-ROC exists for these series; the groundtruth is a libraryts baseline measured with this exact pipeline on 2026-10-15. Tolerance 0.05 is a re-run sanity band (KNN is deterministic), not a paper comparison.
